mapper.select: SELECT content_id AS contentId, MAX(created_at) AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT content_id, created_at FROM user_video_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{since} AND event_type IN (#{play}, #{finish}) UNION ALL SELECT content_id, create_time AS created_at FROM content_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= #{since} ) positive_feedback GROUP BY content_id ORDER BY createdAt DESC, contentId DESC LIMIT #{limit}
